items.title: 不只GPU！輝達CPU搶下Modal業務 挑戰英特爾、超微
items.title_en: Not Just GPUs! Nvidia’s CPU Wins Modal Business, Challenging Intel and AMD
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US)拓展中央處理器(CPU)市場再下一城。快速成長的AI雲端新創Modal宣布，將首次採用輝達新款Vera處理器，執行可替使用者完成長時間任務的AI代理。這類工作過去全由英特爾(INTC-US)與超微(AMD-US)晶片負責，顯示輝達進軍兩大對手長期主導的市場已有初步成果。
Modal向AI開發者出租算力，上周完成由Accel領投的7.5億美元募資，估值達157.5億美元。公司表示，服務使用量已增至原本三倍，營收較去年同期成長逾15倍，未來一年營收可望達10億美元。
Modal周一(19日)表示，初步測試顯示，Vera讓AI代理可完成的工作量提高至原本兩倍，促使公司首度支援輝達的CPU設計，但也需要對軟體進行深入調整。
不過，執行長伯恩哈德森(Erik Bernhardsson)強調，Modal不會放棄既有供應商，而是將輝達晶片與英特爾、超微產品搭配使用，依各項任務需求，分配至表現最好的硬體。
他也指出，這次測試比較的是英特爾與超微已上市的晶片，兩家公司正在開發的新款產品，可能縮小與輝達的差距。Modal將在新品推出後測試，混合使用不同供應商硬體，能讓公司隨時部署效能最佳的產品。
輝達先前向投資人表示，預期本會計年度Vera銷售額至少達200億美元，藉此切入公司估計規模約2,000億美元的CPU市場。除了Modal，輝達曾透露，OpenAI、Anthropic、甲骨文(ORCL-US)及Perplexity等業者也計畫採用Vera，擴大其在AI運算領域的布局。
paras_en: Nvidia (NVDA-US) scores another win as it expands into the central processing unit (CPU) market. Fast‑growing AI cloud startup Modal announced it will for the first time use Nvidia’s new Vera processor to run AI agents that can handle long‑duration tasks for users. Such workloads have historically been handled exclusively by Intel (INTC-US) and AMD (AMD-US) chips, showing that Nvidia is beginning to make inroads into a market long dominated by its two biggest rivals.

Modal rents compute power to AI developers and last week closed a $750 million financing round led by Accel, valuing the company at $15.75 billion. The firm said usage of its services has risen to three times its prior level and revenue has grown more than 15‑fold year‑over‑year, with revenue expected to reach $1 billion within the next year.

On Monday (the 19th), Modal reported that early tests show Vera doubles the amount of work AI agents can accomplish, prompting the company to support Nvidia’s CPU design for the first time, though it also requires deep software adjustments.

However, CEO Erik Bernhardsson stressed that Modal will not abandon its existing suppliers; instead it will pair Nvidia chips with Intel and AMD products, allocating tasks to the hardware that delivers the best performance for each workload.

He also noted that the comparison in this test involved Intel’s and AMD’s currently available chips, and that new products the two companies are developing could narrow the gap with Nvidia. Modal will test after the new releases, and a hybrid approach using hardware from different vendors will allow the company to deploy the most efficient solutions at any time.

Nvidia previously told investors it expects Vera sales to reach at least $20 billion this fiscal year, giving it a foothold in the roughly $200 billion CPU market it estimates. In addition to Modal, Nvidia has disclosed that OpenAI, Anthropic, Oracle (ORCL-US) and Perplexity also plan to use Vera, expanding its footprint in AI computing.

items.title: 美股兩大力量死鬥！美債殖利率狂飆 AI股賺翻也難漲
items.title_en: U.S. Stocks Clash Between Two Forces: Soaring Treasury Yields and AI Stocks Struggle to Rise
paras: 華爾街正迎來一場高風險的正面交鋒。科技與能源巨頭亮眼的企業獲利，正硬生生撞上持續狂飆的債券殖利率。
在人工智慧（AI）技術基礎設施與資料中心建置潮的推動下，法人分析師預期企業獲利將持續強勁成長。正是這份高昂的期待，支撐著標普500等主要指數今年一路克服多重利空。
伊朗局勢推升國際油價衝破每桶百元大關，讓本就承受高物價壓力的消費者負擔加劇；與此同時，10年期與30年期美國公債殖利率攀升至數十年新高，更為股市增添了一道沉重的逆風。
市場走向雙軌化：AI概念股獨撐大局後轉弱
殖利率飆升加劇了美股市場的分化。阿波羅全球管理公司首席經濟學家史洛克（Torsten Slok）指出，當前市場已裂變為「AI概念股」與「非AI概念股」兩大陣營。
自8月起，大盤漲勢明顯收窄，即使大多數個股陷入苦戰，主要指數表面上仍維持高檔。這股平衡直到過去一週才破功，原先強勢的AI概念股突然遭遇賣壓。
雪上加霜的是，即使油價持續走高，美債殖利率出現回檔，反映市場避險情緒升溫；投資人則順勢轉回先前受高利率壓抑的類股與個股。
財報門檻大幅提高：投資人開始質疑AI成長故事
數月以來，投資人將焦點全數鎖定在獲利表現，使AI概念股幾乎免疫於小型股及其他利率敏感股所承受的打擊。
然而，隨著市場對AI驅動的成長敘事開始存疑，這些股票要繼續推升股價的門檻已大幅提高。
在大型銀行與百事可樂（PepsiCo）等消費巨頭搶先公布的財報未能驚艷市場後，恢復市場信心 重擔，已落在即將公布最新財測與業績的AI核心受益股身上。
Nationwide首席市場策略師哈克特（Mark Hackett）直言：「市場的疑慮正持續升溫。」
獲利爆發力對決資金成本：估值修正引發長短力道拉鋸
隨著債券殖利率上周五(16日)繼續攀升，市場似乎正走向兩股強大力量的拉鋸。
Founders 100 ETF投資組合經理莫納漢（Michael Monaghan）表示，一方面，企業獲利成長速度已達到通常只有經濟復甦初期才會出現的強勁水準；另一方面，推升債券殖利率的力量，短期內似乎不太可能消退。
莫納漢表示：「市場正處於拉鋸之中。儘管今年以來股市上漲，但相較於明年的獲利預估，目前股價已便宜許多。」
雖然股價仍有支撐，估值，也就是投資人願意為每一美元預期獲利支付的價格，卻已明顯下滑。根據FactSet資料，截至上周五，標普500指數的預估本益比為19倍，低於過去5年與10年的平均水準。
富達投資全球總經主管提默（Jurrien Timmer）表示，認為科技股能免受日益加劇的總體經濟壓力影響，並不完全正確。
提默在訪談中表示：「可以把它想成獲利成長在分子、資金成本在分母。目前獲利正突飛猛進，但資金成本也在上升。兩者正在競速，就看哪一方對股價的影響更大。」
paras_en: Wall Street is facing a high‑risk head‑to‑head battle. Stellar earnings from tech and energy giants are colliding head‑on with continuously soaring bond yields.

Driven by the wave of AI infrastructure and data‑center construction, sell‑side analysts expect corporate earnings to keep growing strongly. This lofty expectation has helped major indices such as the S&P 500 overcome multiple headwinds this year.

Iran’s situation has pushed international oil prices above $100 a barrel, further burdening consumers already feeling high price pressure; at the same time, 10‑year and 30‑year U.S. Treasury yields have climbed to multi‑decade highs, adding a heavy headwind for equities.
The market is moving on two tracks: AI‑related stocks, after initially supporting the market, are now weakening.

Yield spikes have intensified the split in the U.S. equity market. Torsten Slok, chief economist at Apollo Global Management, notes that the market has now fractured into two camps – “AI‑themed stocks” and “non‑AI stocks.”

Since August, the broad market’s rally has noticeably narrowed. Even though many individual stocks are struggling, the main indices have superficially stayed at elevated levels. This balance only broke in the past week, when once‑strong AI stocks suddenly faced selling pressure.

Adding insult to injury, even as oil prices keep rising, Treasury yields have pulled back, reflecting heightened market‑risk aversion; investors are shifting back into sectors and stocks that were previously suppressed by high rates.
Earnings thresholds have risen sharply: investors begin to doubt the AI growth story
For months, investors have focused exclusively on earnings performance, making AI‑themed stocks almost immune to the blows that hit small‑caps and other rate‑sensitive stocks.
However, as the market’s confidence in AI‑driven growth narratives wanes, the hurdle for these stocks to keep pushing prices higher has risen dramatically.

After earnings from large banks and consumer giants such as PepsiCo failed to wow the market, the burden of restoring confidence now falls on AI‑core beneficiaries that are about to release fresh forecasts and results.
Mark Hackett, chief market strategist at Nationwide, said plainly: “Market concerns are continuing to heat up.”
Earnings explosiveness versus funding costs: valuation adjustments spark a tug‑of‑war between long and short forces
With bond yields continuing to climb on Friday the 16th, the market appears to be caught in a tug‑of‑war between two powerful forces.

Michael Monaghan, portfolio manager of the Founders 100 ETF, said that on one hand, corporate earnings growth has reached a robust pace normally seen only in the early stages of an economic recovery; on the other hand, the forces driving yields higher seem unlikely to subside in the short term.
Monaghan added: “The market is in a tug‑of‑war. Although stocks have risen so far this year, relative to next year’s earnings outlook, today’s prices are already much cheaper.”

While stock prices still have support, valuations – the price investors are willing to pay for each dollar of expected earnings – have clearly slipped. According to FactSet, as of last Friday the S&P 500’s forward P/E ratio stood at 19×, below the five‑year and ten‑year averages.
Jurrien Timmer, global chief economist at Fidelity Investments, said it is not entirely correct to think technology stocks are insulated from the growing macro‑economic pressures.

Timmer explained in an interview: “You can think of it as earnings growth in the numerator and funding costs in the denominator. Earnings are surging, but funding costs are rising too. The two are racing, and it will depend on which side has the bigger impact on stock prices.”

items.title: 工廠八成自動化！西門子攜輝達 用AI拚製造競爭力
items.title_en: Factory Automation Hits 80%: Siemens Teams Up with Nvidia to Boost Manufacturing Competitiveness with AI
paras: 西門子(SIEGY-US)執行董事奈克(Cedrik Neike)周一(19日)表示，公司計畫運用人工智慧(AI)，將工廠製造流程的自動化程度由目前的30%至40%，提高至70%至80%，藉此提升生產效率，協助德國等高薪資國家留住製造業工作機會。
奈克在西門子位於德國埃爾朗根(Erlangen)的電子工廠表示，製造商必須每年實現7%至9%的生產力成長，才能維持競爭力。他認為，AI帶動的自動化升級，有助於高薪資國家維持製造業競爭優勢。
西門子正與輝達(NVDA-US)合作，推動「實體AI」在製造業的應用，透過數位孿生與AI模型，先在虛擬環境中模擬、優化工廠運作，再將成果導入實際生產現場。
西門子也計畫將埃爾朗根電子工廠打造成AI製造示範基地，並於2030年前投入5億歐元，約合5.61億美元，擴建廠區。
paras_en: Siemens (SIEGY-US) Executive Director Cedrik Neike said on Monday (the 19th) that the company plans to use artificial intelligence (AI) to raise the automation level of factory manufacturing processes from the current 30‑40% to 70‑80%, thereby improving production efficiency and helping high‑wage countries such as Germany retain manufacturing jobs.

Neike explained at Siemens' electronics plant in Erlangen, Germany, that manufacturers must achieve 7%‑9% productivity growth each year to stay competitive. He believes that AI‑driven automation upgrades will help high‑wage nations maintain a manufacturing advantage.

Siemens is collaborating with Nvidia (NVDA-US) to promote the use of “physical AI” in manufacturing, employing digital twins and AI models to simulate and optimise plant operations in a virtual environment before applying the results to real‑world production lines.
Siemens also intends to turn the Erlangen electronics plant into an AI‑manufacturing demonstration hub, investing €500 million (about $561 million) by 2030 to expand the facility.

items.title: 通膨才見降溫又升溫！哈塞特坦言仍需下功夫 Fed須留意消費熱度
items.title_en: Inflation Cools Then Heats Up Again! Hassett Says More Work Needed, Fed Must Watch Consumer Heat
paras: 宮國家經濟委員會主任哈塞特(Kevin Hassett)周一(19日)表示，牛肉、雞蛋等商品價格雖已下跌，但美國9月消費者物價數據顯示，整體通膨仍需要政策關注。他也指出，民眾對經濟表現樂觀、增加消費，是聯準會(Fed)必須留意的現象。
哈塞特接受《CNBC》訪問時表示：「如果看前面三個月，通膨看起來已完全受到控制，但現在似乎又需要下一番功夫。」
上周公布的數據顯示，美國9月消費者物價指數(CPI)月增0.6%，創五個月來最大漲幅；排除食品與能源的核心CPI月增0.3%，高於市場預期，反映潛在物價壓力仍未消退。
對於最新數據是否意味通膨趨勢轉變，哈塞特並未下定論。他表示：「這可能代表下降趨勢被打斷，也可能只是短暫波動。」
在通膨再度受到關注之際，市場預期Fed將於本月底會議維持利率不變。Fed主席華許(Kevin Warsh)上周出席國際貨幣基金(IMF)年會的一場座談時，除了重申Fed將實現物價穩定，並未評論貨幣政策或美國經濟展望，也未打消市場對利率按兵不動的預期。
哈塞特表示，他尊重央行獨立性，相信華許會「做他認為正確的事」。
他同時指出，強勁的消費意願也是Fed評估政策時需要考量的因素。「人們對經濟表現如此良好感到非常振奮，因此增加支出。當然，這正是Fed需要留意的情況。」
paras_en: Kevin Hassett, director of the White House Council of Economic Advisers, said on Monday (the 19th) that while prices for items such as beef and eggs have fallen, September U.S. consumer price data show that overall inflation still requires policy attention. He also noted that the public’s optimism about the economy and increased spending are phenomena the Federal Reserve must monitor.
In an interview with CNBC, Hassett said, "If you look at the past three months, inflation seemed fully under control, but now it looks like we need to put in another round of effort."

Data released last week showed that the U.S. September Consumer Price Index (CPI) rose 0.6% month‑over‑month, the biggest increase in five months; the core CPI, which excludes food and energy, rose 0.3% month‑over‑month, above market expectations, indicating that underlying price pressures have not yet eased.

When asked whether the latest data signaled a shift in the inflation trend, Hassett did not draw a firm conclusion. He said, "It could mean the downward trend was interrupted, or it could just be a temporary blip."

As inflation comes back into focus, markets expect the Fed to keep rates unchanged at its meeting at the end of the month. Fed Chair Kevin Warsh, who attended a panel at the IMF annual meeting last week, reiterated the Fed’s commitment to price stability but did not comment on monetary policy, the U.S. economic outlook, or dispel expectations that rates would stay on hold.
Hassett said he respects the central bank’s independence and believes Warsh will "do what he thinks is right."

He also pointed out that strong consumer willingness to spend is a factor the Fed must consider when evaluating policy. "People are so encouraged by the good economic performance that they increase spending. Of course, that’s exactly what the Fed needs to watch."

items.title: 別急著低接科技股！那指反彈淪「假突破」 分析師示警這次不一樣
items.title_en: Don't Rush to Buy Tech Stocks Low! Nasdaq Rally Turns Into a "False Breakout" – Analysts Warn This Time Is Different
paras: 每當有人聲稱「這次不一樣」，華爾街往往抱持懷疑態度，因為市場趨勢經常比預期維持得更久。
儘管目前要斷言科技股的長期多頭格局已經結束或許尚早，但多項技術指標已明確發出「切勿盲目抄底」的訊號，即使「逢低承接」策略今年以來多次奏效，甚至上個月才剛帶來豐厚回報。
代表科技股重要風向球的那斯達克綜合指數，科技類股權重高達64.9%。儘管該指數在上周四出現強勁反彈，但從技術線型來看，最糟糕的時刻恐怕尚未過去。
上周五(16日)那斯達克指數重挫2.1%，收在近一個月新低，並創下四個月來最大單周跌幅。
跌破50日線 上升趨勢線也失守
Piper Sandler首席市場技術分析師Craig Johnson並未直接宣稱「這次不一樣」，但他指出，這波回檔確實有別於先前。他觀察到市場整體狀況已明顯惡化，足以判斷中期趨勢正在轉弱，並表示：「我現在不急著逢低買進。」
FactSet數據顯示，那指周五收在26,140點，低於26,631點的50日移動平均線。許多技術分析人士將50日均線視為短期趨勢指標，因此收盤跌破這條均線，意味短線趨勢已轉為下行。
不過，這並非新現象。那指先前曾多次跌破50日均線，卻未破壞長期上升趨勢。最近一次就在上個月，當時指數連續兩天收在50日均線下方，卻在僅三個交易日後大漲，收盤再創歷史新高。
這次的一大差異在於，先前跌破50日均線時的低點，反而構成了自3月30日近八個月低點延伸而上的上升趨勢線。當趨勢線至少連接三個點時，技術意義就更為明確。
如今那指跌破這條上升趨勢線，成為本輪賣壓有別於近期幾次回檔的另一項訊號。
創高淪為假突破 短線恐續盤整
Johnson進一步指出，那指線圖顯示，在指數突破並於9月底、10月初創下歷史新高後追買科技股的投資人，遭到突破訊號誤導。
他在客戶報告中寫道，那指跌破前一周低點，也失守先前推動指數於10月初創高的支撐位，形成「創新高後假突破」型態。
他表示，雖然這本身尚不足以扭轉主要上升趨勢，「但確實意味短期內可能出現盤整或回檔」。
市場廣度疲弱 上漲個股不足三成
Johnson補充，目前市場內部結構相當疲弱，也是這次與那指9月及7月回檔不同的另一項技術面因素。
他指出，根據其趨勢分析，處於周線上升趨勢的股票占比不到27%；公司追蹤的26周新高指標與40周「Technique」指標，則仍處於年內低點，並持續發出中期賣出訊號。
FactSet數據也顯示，儘管那指上周才創下歷史新高，目前距離該高點僅回落略逾5%，但那斯達克交易所創52周新低的股票家數，已連續35天多於創52周新高的家數。
這是自2025年4月22日結束的連續43天紀錄以來，最長的一段期間。當時那指較四個月前創下的歷史收盤高點下跌19.2%。
Johnson表示：「這個市場的趨勢疲弱、市場廣度疲弱，參與上漲的個股也少。」
下一道關卡看200日線
接下來值得關注的關鍵均線是200日移動平均線，那指自3月以來尚未跌破這條均線。許多市場人士將其視為長期多空趨勢的分界線。
FactSet數據顯示，200日均線目前位於24,919點，意味那指若從周五收盤價回落至此，還有約4.7%的下跌空間。
paras_en: Whenever someone claims "this time is different," Wall Street is usually skeptical, because market trends often persist longer than expected.

Although it may be premature to declare that the long‑term bull market in tech stocks is over, several technical indicators have clearly sounded a "do not blindly bottom‑fish" warning, even though the "buy the dip" strategy has worked multiple times this year and only last month delivered hefty returns.

The Nasdaq Composite, the key barometer for tech stocks, has a tech weighting of 64.9%. Although the index posted a strong rebound last Thursday, the technical chart suggests the worst may still be ahead.
On Friday (the 16th) the Nasdaq fell 2.1%, closing at a one‑month low and marking the biggest weekly drop in four months.
It broke below the 50‑day moving average and also lost its upward trend line.

Piper Sandler’s chief market technologist Craig Johnson didn’t outright say "this time is different," but he noted that this pullback is indeed unlike previous ones. He observed that overall market conditions have deteriorated enough to judge that the medium‑term trend is weakening, and he said, "I’m not in a hurry to buy on the dip right now."

FactSet data shows the index closed Friday at 26,140 points, below the 50‑day moving average of 26,631 points. Many technical analysts treat the 50‑day average as a short‑term trend indicator, so closing below it signals a shift to a downtrend in the short term.

However, this is not a new phenomenon. The Nasdaq has broken below the 50‑day average many times before without destroying the long‑term uptrend. The most recent instance was last month, when the index stayed below the 50‑day line for two consecutive days but then surged within three trading sessions to close at a new all‑time high.

The big difference this time is that the low when the index previously fell below the 50‑day average actually formed an upward trend line extending from the March 30 low, the lowest point in nearly eight months. When a trend line connects at least three points, its technical significance becomes clearer.
Now the Nasdaq has broken that upward trend line, providing another signal that this round of selling differs from the recent pullbacks.
New‑highs Turned Into False Breakouts, Short‑Term Consolidation Likely

Johnson further pointed out that the Nasdaq chart shows investors who chased tech stocks after the index broke out and set new highs at the end of September and early October were misled by the breakout signal.

In his client report he wrote that the Nasdaq fell below the prior week’s low and also broke the support that had propelled the index to its early‑October high, creating a "false breakout after a new high" pattern.
He said that while this alone is not enough to reverse the primary uptrend, it does suggest that a short‑term consolidation or pullback is possible.
Market Breadth Weak, Fewer Than 30% of Stocks Advancing
Johnson added that the internal market structure is quite weak right now, which is another technical factor distinguishing this move from the September and July pullbacks.

He noted that, according to his trend analysis, less than 27% of stocks are in a weekly uptrend; the 26‑week new‑high metric and the 40‑week "Technique" indicator that his firm tracks remain at year‑low levels and continue to emit medium‑term sell signals.

FactSet data also shows that although the Nasdaq set a fresh all‑time high just last week and is only about 5% off that peak, the number of stocks on the Nasdaq hitting 52‑week lows has outnumbered those hitting 52‑week highs for 35 consecutive days.
This is the longest stretch since a 43‑day run that ended on April 22 2025, when the Nasdaq was down 19.2% from the closing high it had set four months earlier.
Johnson said, "The market trend is weak, market breadth is weak, and there are few stocks participating in the rally."
Next Barrier: The 200‑Day Moving Average

The next key moving average to watch is the 200‑day moving average, which the Nasdaq has not broken since March. Many market participants view it as the dividing line between long‑term bullish and bearish trends.
FactSet data shows the 200‑day average is currently at 24,919 points, meaning that if the Nasdaq falls from Friday’s close back to that level, there is roughly a 4.7% downside potential.

items.title: 砸錢拚算力 最後誰賺錢？避險基金投資長撰文示警AI獲利難題
items.title_en: Spending Big on Compute: Who Ultimately Profits? A Hedge Fund CIO Warns of AI Profit Challenges
paras: AI需求持續擴張，是否就代表模型開發商能長期獲取高額利潤？One River資產管理投資長彼得斯(Eric Peters)在一篇投資評論中，透過與投資人Sparks的對話提出另一種思考：隨著融資成本攀升，AI基礎建設熱潮可能面臨資金考驗，而最終受益最大的，未必是生產AI服務的公司，而是善用這些服務的企業。
文章中的Sparks是一名投資人與創業家。對於當前投資環境，他以「典型的景氣循環末期」形容，認為判斷行情能否延續，不能只看技術採用率與需求成長，也必須檢視支撐投資的資金流向，以及企業取得資本的成本。

融資成本攀升 市場可能從怕錯過轉為怕接盤

Sparks認為，大型投資循環進入後期時，金融交易往往變得更加複雜，風險也更難辨識。他以金融危機前的擔保債務憑證(CDO)及再證券化商品為例指出，越接近循環尾聲，最後發行的證券往往越複雜、越難理解，也越危險。
在他的分析中，轉折不一定始於需求崩跌，而可能先出現在融資條件轉差。當資金成本上升，部分原本勉強可行的投資案便不再划算，整體擴張速度也會隨之放緩。
對債券投資人而言，若既有持債價格下跌，新融資案又必須提供更高利率才能吸引資金，便會重新評估承擔風險的意願。資金供應轉趨保守，又可能進一步推高企業融資成本，形成相互強化的壓力。
「投資人會從害怕錯過，轉為害怕成為最後接手的人。」Sparks表示，這種轉變不會一夕完成，但等到警訊已經明顯到所有人都能察覺時，往往已錯過調整時機。
他認為，市場形成重大高點是一段過程，通常先由財務較弱的業者承受壓力，再逐步侵蝕支撐整體行情的基礎。不過，這是他對市場循環的判斷，並不代表股市轉折的時間已能確定。

AI需求不等於高利潤 模型業者恐更像公用事業

除了融資風險，文章另一個核心問題是：AI企業投入龐大資本建置算力後，究竟能形成具有定價能力的事業，還是陷入資本密集、利潤有限的競爭？
Sparks以亞馬遜(AMZN-US)為例指出，若扣除雲端服務AWS與廣告業務，其核心仍是零售與物流，而這類生意通常需要大量資本，利潤率也相對有限。相較之下，他認為Alphabet(GOOGL-US)旗下Google的市場地位與高利潤，更接近投資人期待的商業模式。
因此，AI需求規模有多大，與模型開發商能留下多少利潤，是兩個不同的問題。即使未來經濟活動廣泛使用AI，帶動Token需求激增，也不能直接推論最先進的模型開發商就是最大贏家。
Sparks以電力產業類比：自電力商業化以來，全球用電量大幅成長，但持有公用事業並不必然是創造巨額財富的最佳途徑。需求持續擴張，也可能伴隨高額設備支出與激烈競爭。
在他看來，將電力與運算資源轉化為Token的過程，可能更接近公用事業，而非能長期維持壟斷優勢的高利潤生意。
這項觀點並非否定AI的用途，而是提醒投資人區分技術價值與投資報酬。若模型服務日益普及、競爭壓低價格，真正獲得較大經濟效益的，可能是利用AI降低成本、改善產品與提高生產力的企業，而非投入巨資供應模型服務的業者。
paras_en: AI demand keeps expanding, but does that mean model developers can sustain high profits? Eric Peters, CIO of One River Asset Management, in an investment commentary raises another view through a conversation with investor Sparks: as financing costs rise, the AI infrastructure boom may face funding tests, and the biggest beneficiaries may not be the companies producing AI services, but the firms that effectively use those services.

In the article, Sparks is an investor and entrepreneur. He describes the current investment climate as a "typical late-stage business cycle" and argues that judging whether a market can continue requires looking beyond technology adoption rates and demand growth, also examining the flow of capital supporting investments and the cost of capital for companies.

Rising financing costs may shift the market from fear of missing out to fear of being the last buyer. Sparks says that in the later stages of a large investment cycle, financial transactions become more complex and risks harder to identify. He cites pre‑crisis collateralized debt obligations (CDOs) and re‑securitizations, noting that securities issued toward the end of a cycle tend to be more complex, harder to understand, and riskier.

In his analysis, the turning point may not start with a demand collapse but could appear first in deteriorating financing conditions. When capital costs rise, some projects that were barely viable become uneconomic, slowing overall expansion.

For bond investors, if existing bond prices fall and new issuances must offer higher yields to attract capital, risk appetite is reassessed. A more conservative supply of funds can further push up corporate financing costs, creating a reinforcing pressure loop.

"Investors shift from fearing they’ll miss out to fearing they’ll be the one left holding the bag," Sparks says. This shift won’t happen overnight, and by the time warning signs are obvious to everyone, the window for adjustment is often already missed.

He believes that a market’s major peak forms gradually, usually first pressuring financially weaker firms, which then erode the foundation supporting the broader rally. However, this is his view of market cycles and does not pinpoint the exact timing of a stock‑market turn.

AI demand does not equal high profit; model providers may resemble utilities. Beyond financing risk, the article’s core question is whether AI companies that pour massive capital into compute can build businesses with pricing power or become capital‑intensive, low‑margin competitors.

Sparks uses Amazon (AMZN‑US) as an example: stripping out AWS cloud services and advertising, its core remains retail and logistics—businesses that require heavy capital and yield limited margins. By contrast, he sees Alphabet’s (GOOGL‑US) Google, with its market position and high profitability, as closer to the business model investors desire.

Thus, the size of AI demand and the profit margin that model developers can retain are separate issues. Even if AI becomes ubiquitous in economic activity and drives a surge in token demand, it does not automatically follow that the most advanced model developers will be the biggest winners.

Sparks draws an analogy to the electricity sector: since electricity was commercialized, global consumption has surged, yet owning utilities has not necessarily been the best path to massive wealth. Expanding demand can also bring high equipment costs and fierce competition.
In his view, converting electricity and compute resources into tokens is more akin to a utility than a high‑margin, monopoly‑sustaining business.

This perspective does not deny AI’s usefulness; it reminds investors to separate technological value from investment returns. If model services become widespread and competition drives prices down, the firms that reap the biggest economic benefits are likely those that use AI to cut costs, improve products, and boost productivity—not the ones pouring huge sums into supplying model services.

paras: 美股周一(19日)開盤走高，AI相關股票在上周遭遇猛烈拋售後吸引逢低買盤，大型晶片股反彈，帶動標普500與那斯達克指數上揚，油價回落也為市場提供支撐。隨著本周重要企業財報陸續登場，投資人押注AI投資熱潮仍能支撐企業獲利，科技股成長動能能否延續將成為關注焦點。
截稿前，道瓊工業指數跌近40點或近0.07%，那斯達克綜合指數漲近270點或1.0%，標普 500 指數漲近0.6%，費城半導體指數漲近2.8%，台積電ADR漲近1.6%。
美國股指期貨周一走高，晶片股上周重挫後出現反彈，為本周財報密集公布揭開序幕。Meta(META-US)、特斯拉(TSLA-US)即將交出成績單，將再度考驗投資人對人工智慧(AI)行情的信心，焦點在於企業獲利能否支撐龐大投資，以及日益昂貴的融資成本。
那斯達克100指數期貨上漲1.3%，收復上周累跌5.5%的部分失土；標普500指數期貨上漲0.5%。一檔追蹤晶片股的ETF盤前勁揚3.6%，有望迎來10個交易日以來首度收漲。歐洲則受法國周末暴力抗議拖累，Stoxx 600指數下跌0.9%。
晶片股止跌反彈 AI融資疑慮仍未散
AI類股近期承壓，市場擔憂企業能否維持獲利高速成長，並在舉債成本攀升之際，持續支應大規模投資。
WisdomTree研究主管古普塔(Aneeka Gupta)表示，上周市場恐慌源於融資問題，而非需求轉弱，因此這波反彈有其依據，卻也同樣脆弱。
AI雲端業者CoreWeave(CRWV-US)盤前上漲逾6%，此前一周重挫25%。該公司一直處於AI企業籌資疑慮的風暴中心，旗下非投資等級債券殖利率已攀升至15%。
《彭博》策略師指出，真正風險在於融資壓力向外擴散。AI對經濟的重要性已足以讓資金緊張演變成更廣泛的成長問題，但目前證據仍有限；股市跌勢主要集中於AI融資相關標的，資金較像是在類股間輪動，而非全面撤出。
法國動盪拖累歐股 大摩看回檔醞釀機會
法國周末因生活成本問題爆發社會動盪，公共建築、商店與餐廳接連遭攻擊。但沉重債務及歐元區名列前茅的預算赤字，限制政府透過增加支出回應民怨的空間。
法國公債領跌歐洲債市，與德國公債的殖利率利差擴大，歐元也是主要貨幣中表現最弱者。美元大致持平，布蘭特原油則自五個月高點回落；美國短天期公債價格小跌，先前股市拋售曾帶動避險買盤。
花旗(C-US)歐股策略主管曼西(Beata Manthey)認為，法股波動可能延續至冬季之後，甚至下一屆總統大選，部分取決於國會能否推動債務改革。她表示，許多利空已反映在價格中，但市場仍可能反覆震盪。
摩根士丹利(MS-US)策略師威爾森(Michael Wilson)則認為，部分股市的回檔接近尾聲，優質股領先、標普500等權重指數偏弱的格局將逐漸消退。他建議投資人做好準備，無論市場快速完成調整，或跌勢緩慢延續至11月，屆時都可能是增加風險部位的機會。

paras_en: U.S. equities opened higher on Monday (the 19th), with AI‑related stocks attracting dip‑buying after last week’s sharp sell‑off, and large‑cap chip stocks rebounding, lifting the S&P 500 and Nasdaq indexes. Lower oil prices also gave the market a boost. With a slate of major earnings reports due this week, investors are betting that the AI investment boom can still sustain corporate profits, making the continuation of tech‑stock growth momentum a key focus.

At the time of writing, the Dow Jones Industrial Average was down about 40 points, or roughly 0.07%, the Nasdaq Composite was up about 270 points, or 1.0%, the S&P 500 was up about 0.6%, the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index rose about 2.8%, and TSMC ADR gained about 1.6%.

U.S. index futures were higher on Monday, with chip stocks bouncing back after last week’s heavy losses, setting the stage for this week’s earnings wave. Meta (META‑US) and Tesla (TSLA‑US) are about to release results, which will again test investors’ confidence in the AI rally, focusing on whether corporate earnings can support massive spending amid rising financing costs.

Nasdaq‑100 futures rose 1.3%, recapturing the 5.5% loss it had accumulated last week; S&P 500 futures were up 0.5%. An ETF that tracks chip stocks jumped 3.6% in pre‑market trading, poised for its first daily gain in ten trading days. Europe, however, was weighed down by violent protests in France over the weekend, with the Stoxx 600 slipping 0.9%.
Chip stocks stopped falling and rebounded, but AI financing concerns remain unresolved.
AI‑related shares have been under pressure lately as the market worries whether companies can keep their high profit growth while debt costs climb, yet still fund large‑scale investments.
Aneeka Gupta, research head at WisdomTree, said last week’s market panic stemmed from financing issues rather than weakening demand, so the rebound has a basis but is also fragile.

AI cloud provider CoreWeave (CRWV‑US) was up more than 6% in pre‑market trading after a 25% plunge the previous week. The company has been at the centre of the AI‑funding storm, with its non‑investment‑grade bond yields climbing to 15%.

Bloomberg strategists noted that the real risk is financing pressure spilling over. AI’s importance to the economy is enough to turn tight liquidity into a broader growth problem, though evidence is still limited; the stock‑market decline is mainly concentrated in AI‑financing‑related names, with money rotating within the sector rather than exiting entirely.
French turmoil drags down European stocks; Morgan Stanley sees pull‑back as a brewing opportunity.

France experienced social unrest over the weekend due to cost‑of‑living issues, with public buildings, shops and restaurants attacked. Heavy debt and a large budget deficit relative to the euro‑zone limit the government’s ability to respond to public anger by increasing spending.

French government bonds led the European bond market lower, widening the yield spread with German bunds, while the euro was the weakest of the major currencies. The dollar was roughly flat, Brent crude fell from a five‑month high, and short‑term U.S. Treasury prices slipped slightly after the earlier equity sell‑off sparked a flight to safety.

Beata Manthey, head of European equities strategy at Citi (C‑US), said French market volatility could persist into the winter and possibly through the next presidential election, depending in part on whether parliament can push through debt reform. She added that many downside factors are already priced in, but the market may still see repeated swings.

Michael Wilson, a strategist at Morgan Stanley (MS‑US), believes the pull‑back in some equity markets is nearing its end, and the current pattern of quality stocks leading while the S&P 500 and other heavyweight indexes lag will gradually fade. He advises investors to be ready, whether the market completes a rapid adjustment or a slower decline into November, as both scenarios could present opportunities to add risk assets.

Netflix (NFLX‑US) will report its Q3 earnings after the U.S. market close on Tuesday (the 20th). With streaming competition intensifying and user engagement showing signs of fatigue, investors are watching how the streaming giant will sustain growth. The market expects Netflix’s Q3 revenue growth to be the lowest in three years, and whether live‑streaming and advertising can provide new momentum will be the focus of the report.

Intel (INTC‑US) rose nearly 4% in pre‑market trading after JPMorgan upgraded its rating from "Underweight" to "Neutral." Analyst Harlan Sur said that although the transformation will take several years, management’s execution has been solid, gradually boosting confidence in the company.

Amazon (AMZN‑US) rose more than 1% in pre‑market trading after Morgan Stanley named it a top‑pick and raised its target price. Wilson pointed out that the outperformance of the quality factor over equal‑weight indexes is waning, which could provide an excellent opportunity for investors to add stocks on dips.

In a client note, Wilson stated clearly: "We recommend investors be prepared, whether the market undergoes a rapid adjustment or a slow consolidation into November. In our view, both scenarios will be times to increase risk assets rather than avoid risk." He emphasized that this pull‑back represents a buying opportunity, not the start of a new bear market.

items.title_en: French Prime Minister Calls for Local Curfews to Protect Shops from Looters
paras: 法國總理勒科爾尼19日（周一）說，要求地方各省政府根據情況宵禁，保護商鋪免受破壞分子劫掠。
勒科爾尼說，若有必要，可宣布國家進入緊急狀態。
法國當地政府19日早些時候宣布，當天12時至20時，法國第二大城市馬賽禁止一切公共集會或示威活動。
勒科爾尼在結束跨部門危機應對會議後表示，政府將於當天啟動大規模司法行動，追究近期暴力事件中涉事人員的責任。
法國多地17日發生遊行示威和抗議活動，部分地區出現暴力行為。
法國總統馬克宏18日晚就相關事件發表電視講話，他譴責抗議期間出現的暴力行徑，呼籲不要將訴求表達與暴力混為一談，並表示將對其中違法行為追究法律責任。
paras_en: French Prime Minister Le Corni said on Monday the 19th that local provincial governments should impose curfews as needed to protect shops from looters and vandals.
Le Corni added that, if necessary, a state of emergency could be declared.
Local authorities announced earlier on the 19th that from 12:00 to 20:00 the country’s second‑largest city, Marseille, would ban all public gatherings or demonstrations.

After concluding an inter‑ministerial crisis‑response meeting, Le Corni said the government would launch a large‑scale judicial operation that day to hold those involved in recent violent incidents accountable.
On the 17th, protests and demonstrations erupted in many parts of France, with some regions experiencing violent acts.

President Emmanuel Macron delivered a televised address on the evening of the 18th, condemning the violence during the protests, urging that demands not be conflated with violence, and stating that illegal actions would be prosecuted.

items.title: 台玻T-glass獲認證、高階玻纖布持續出貨 法人給予投資建議點讚
items.title_en: Taiwan Glass T‑glass Certified, High‑End Fiberglass Cloth Continues Shipping; Institutional Investors Praise Investment Recommendation
paras: 玻陶廠台玻(1802-TW)受惠LOW DK高階玻纖布持續出貨，加上T-glass已通過國內外廠商認證，上(9)月營收月增8.1%、年增34.1%，優於市場預期。法人指出，在產品挹注營收、毛利率成長動能下，對台玻未來營運狀況樂觀，也給予「買進」評等。
台玻近年持續從傳產強化轉型腳步，受惠於AI產業需求持續蓬勃發展，逐步轉型為電子材料廠，布局玻纖布等相關產品，包括台玻T-glass目前已通過國內外廠商認證，加上Low Dk(低介電)系列高階玻纖布持續出貨下，持續挹注營收增長，今(2026)年累計前9月合併營收已年增達18.6%。
法人報告指出，台玻受惠AI伺服器與高速運算帶動材料升級，低介電、低熱膨脹係數玻纖布需求增溫，擴充高階產能，包括日廠Nittobo也再次強調T-glass需求已非當前公司擴產速度所能消化，顯示產品需求強勁，若未來國內外廠商持續調漲玻纖布產品報價，台玻有望受惠漲價效應挹注業績。
台玻董事長林伯豐今年也表示，今年度持續投入20億元擴充產線，確保 Low DK及Low CTE玻纖布供應能力，目前供需仍相當吃緊狀況下，預估產品供不應求情況將延續至明(2027)年。
台玻今年在高階玻纖布產線規劃上，也從4條擴增至12條，力拚出貨產能因應客戶需求。
分析師今日則表示，台玻的LOW DK玻纖布已通過認證，包括AI大廠輝達(NVDA-US)產品，也需要高階玻纖布的供應料件，目前根據高階玻纖布出貨量觀察，台玻占市場約40%左右，高階產品經營客戶認證下，與以往景氣循環股的台玻產品不同，加上法人估明年業績有望增長下，長線看好台玻股價發展。
paras_en: Glass‑ceramic manufacturer Taiwan Glass (1802‑TW) benefited from continued shipments of its low‑dielectric (LOW DK) high‑end fiberglass cloth, and its T‑glass has passed certifications from both domestic and overseas manufacturers. In September, revenue rose 8.1% month‑over‑month and 34.1% year‑over‑year, beating market expectations. Institutions noted that product‑driven revenue and margin growth give a positive outlook for Taiwan Glass’s future operations and assigned a “Buy” rating.

In recent years Taiwan Glass has been strengthening its transformation from a traditional manufacturer toward an electronic‑materials company, driven by the booming AI industry. It has been expanding into products such as fiberglass cloth. Its T‑glass has now cleared certifications from domestic and foreign customers, and the ongoing shipments of its low‑dielectric (Low Dk) high‑end fiberglass cloth continue to feed revenue growth. For the first nine months of 2026, consolidated revenue was up 18.6% year‑over‑year.

The institutional report points out that Taiwan Glass is benefiting from AI servers and high‑speed computing that are prompting material upgrades. Demand for low‑dielectric, low‑coefficient‑of‑thermal‑expansion (Low CTE) fiberglass cloth is rising, prompting expansion of high‑end capacity. Even Japanese partner Nittobo reiterated that T‑glass demand now exceeds the company’s current expansion speed, indicating strong product demand. If domestic and overseas customers keep raising fiberglass‑cloth prices, Taiwan Glass could capture the price‑increase effect in its earnings.

Chairman Lin Bo‑feng said the company will invest NT$20 billion this year to expand production lines, ensuring supply capacity for Low DK and Low CTE fiberglass cloth. With supply still tight, the company expects the shortage to persist into 2027.
This year Taiwan Glass expanded its high‑end fiberglass‑cloth production lines from four to twelve, striving to increase shipping capacity to meet customer demand.

Analysts noted today that Taiwan Glass’s LOW DK fiberglass cloth has earned certifications, including for AI giant NVIDIA’s (NVDA‑US) products, which also require high‑end fiberglass cloth components. Based on shipment data, Taiwan Glass now holds roughly 40% of the high‑end market. Unlike its traditional cyclical‑stock profile, the certified high‑end product line and institutional expectations of earnings growth next year lead analysts to be bullish on the long‑term price development of Taiwan Glass’s stock.

items.title: 科普環島列車啟程 國科會：AI時代更需培育科研新秀
items.title_en: Science Outreach Island Train Departs; Academia Sinica: AI Era Calls for Nurturing New Research Talent
paras: 「2026台灣科普環島列車」今(19)日起從台北車站出發，展開為期6天的全台科學之旅。國科會主委吳誠文表示，台灣要成為科技強國，科研發展與人才培育是重要基礎，國科會與數發部推動AI基本法中，很重要的原則就是人類自主，AI在某些特定應用裡能力會超越人類，但終究僅是一個工具，人類自主最重要的就是從小認識科學。
今年科普列車以「車門一開，未來展開」為主題，將半導體、太空、智慧醫療等前瞻領域導入車廂體驗，目的就是要在課堂之外激發年輕世代的好奇心與創造力，為國家永續發展蓄積最堅實的科研新血。
吳誠文表示，國科會期盼持續推動科普活動，目前很多人憂慮AI快速發展會不會最後對人類造成傷害？AI Doom(末日論)是不是真的存在？但國科會與數發部推動AI基本法裡面一個很重要的原則就是人類自主，AI在某些特定應用裡，能力會超越人類，但它僅是人類使用的一個工具，人類必須善用這個工具，從設計工具到使用工具，都要確保是在人類可以控制的範圍之下。
吳誠文說，國科會協助國家推動科普教育，讓民眾可以認同科學的基本原理，觸發大家的探索心、好奇心，不斷努力促進科技發展，才能真正掌控自己的未來，發展出更好的工具來協助我們，而民間企業未來能好好善用科技實力，不能缺少青出於藍的年輕人進到科技領域。
台鐵公司董事長鄭光遠也說，台鐵很榮幸能與國科會攜手合作，以鐵道路網作為科學教育推廣的平台，未來也將持續以安全、可靠的運輸服務，支持更多教育推廣活動。

國科會指出，今年科普環島列車打造8節「移動實驗室」主題車廂，由數發部、台灣默克集團、友達永續基金會、瑞健醫療、上銀公司(2049-TW)、國研院海洋科技研究中心與國家地震工程研究中心、國家太空中心、世界(5347-TW)先進積體電路公司、Tokyo Electron Taiwan及財育秀教育基金會等單位共同規劃，內容橫跨海洋科技、太空探索、防震知識、綠色永續、智慧醫療、通訊技術、尖端材料及食品科學等領域。
paras_en: The "2026 Taiwan Science Outreach Island Train" set off from Taipei Station today (19th) for a six‑day nationwide scientific tour. Academia Sinica Council Chair Wu Cheng‑wen said that for Taiwan to become a technology powerhouse, research development and talent cultivation are essential foundations. The council, together with the Ministry of Digital Affairs, is promoting an AI Basic Law that emphasizes human autonomy: while AI may surpass humans in certain specific applications, it remains merely a tool, and fostering scientific awareness from a young age is paramount.

This year’s outreach train, themed “Open the Door, Unfold the Future,” brings forward‑looking fields such as semiconductors, space and smart healthcare into the train cars, aiming to spark curiosity and creativity among the younger generation beyond the classroom and to build a solid pipeline of new researchers for the nation’s sustainable development.

Wu Cheng‑wen noted that the council hopes to keep advancing science outreach. Many worry whether rapid AI development could ultimately harm humanity—does an AI “doom” really exist? The AI Basic Law’s key principle is human autonomy: AI may out‑perform humans in certain tasks, but it is only a tool for human use. Humans must employ it wisely, ensuring that both its design and deployment stay within controllable limits.

Wu added that the council assists the nation in promoting science education so the public can appreciate basic scientific principles, ignite exploration and curiosity, and continuously drive technological progress. Only then can we truly control our future, develop better tools to aid us, and ensure private enterprises can leverage technological strength with a new generation of talent entering the tech sector.

Taiwan Railways Administration Chairman Cheng Kuang‑yuan also expressed pride in collaborating with Academia Sinica, using the rail network as a platform for science education outreach. He said the railway will continue to support more educational activities with safe, reliable transport services.

The council highlighted that this year’s island train features eight “mobile laboratory” themed cars, jointly planned by the Ministry of Digital Affairs, Taiwan Merck Group, AU Optronics Sustainable Foundation, Ruijian Medical, Hiwin Technologies (2049‑TW), National Academy of Marine Technology, National Center for Earthquake Engineering Research, National Space Center, World (5347‑TW) Advanced Integrated Circuit Company, Tokyo Electron Taiwan, and the Caixiu Education Foundation. The content spans marine technology, space exploration, seismic safety, green sustainability, smart healthcare, communications, advanced materials, and food science.

items.title: 中保旗下國雲智慧停車 登韓國首亮相AI「智慧停車管理數據中心」
items.title_en: China Insurance's Guoyun Smart Parking Debuts AI "Smart Parking Management Data Center" at Korea's First International Showcase
paras: 中保科技(9917-TW)集團旗下的「國雲智慧停車」創新再度登上國際舞台。於南韓江陵隆重舉行的智慧交通界最高盛會「2026江陵ITS世界大會（ITS World Congress）」上，由中保科技董事長林建涵、國雲智慧停車董事長張奕春等今(19）日宣布，發表全台首創「智慧停車管理數據中心」登上國際級展會盛大展出。
中保旗下國雲智慧停車並在此地成功向全球展現台灣在路邊智慧停車、AIoT 軟硬體整合與數據治理上的頂尖實力，交通部政務次長陳彥伯也親自來到韓國江陵ITS世界大會現場參訪。
中保科技董事長林建涵指出，國雲智慧停車深耕台灣路邊停車管理近20年，今(2026)年首度發表「智慧停車管理數據中心」，核心優勢在於「軟硬體的高度整合與升級」。國雲針對原本既有的路邊智慧停車硬體設備（如智慧地磁、高/中/低位影像辨識柱及車牌辨識系統等），全面導入後台智慧管理中心與 AI 運算軟體平台，打破以往硬體設備分散獨立運作的限制。
國雲智慧停車董事長張奕春分析，透過軟硬體的深度結合，管理中心串聯了現場設備、即時影像監控與第一線運維人員，實時將城市各角落的停車數據匯入中心，形成「設備連線 × 數據監控 × 資料整合」的協同運作機制。透過巨型監控牆與可視化數據儀表板，管理者能一目瞭然掌握開單量、即時周轉率、繳費進度與催繳動態，將既有硬體收集到的現場資訊，真正轉化為可追蹤、可執行的智慧治理決策。
此外，平台具備深入的路段壓力分析功能，能精準判讀高需求熱點與尖峰壓力，並結合申訴與服務品質指標，協助市府機關彈性調整費率、科學化配置裝卸車格與調度巡查人力，達到「用數據看見治理重點、提升市民滿意度」的目標。

中保科技目前這套「智慧停車管理數據中心」先建置於台中，也是落實公私協力邁向智慧治理，打造低碳永續城市關鍵布局。國雲智慧停車總經理古昌灝分析，停車位不只是靜止的設施，更是反映城市脈動的感知節點。透過「智慧停車管理數據中心」軟硬兼備的完整系統，不僅為台灣打造出高效率、具財務可行性的智慧停車示範場域，更透過無紙化開單與智慧導引尋車，大幅降低車輛繞行產生的碳排放。未來，中保科技與國雲智慧停車將持續攜手各縣市政府，以科技賦能城市管理，共同邁向更智慧、更永續的低碳城市。
paras_en: China Insurance Technology (9917-TW) Group's "Guoyun Smart Parking" innovation once again takes the international stage. At South Korea's Gangneung, the premier smart transportation event "2026 Gangneung ITS World Congress" was held, where China Insurance Technology Chairman Lin Jianhan and Guoyun Smart Parking Chairman Zhang Yichun announced today (the 19th) the launch of Taiwan’s first "Smart Parking Management Data Center," showcased at the international exhibition.

Guoyun Smart Parking, a subsidiary of China Insurance, successfully demonstrated Taiwan’s leading capabilities in roadside smart parking, AIoT hardware‑software integration, and data governance to a global audience, with Ministry of Transportation Deputy Minister Chen Yanbo personally visiting the Gangneung ITS World Congress site in Korea.

Chairman Lin Jianhan noted that Guoyun Smart Parking has been deep‑rooted in Taiwan’s roadside parking management for nearly 20 years, and this 2026 debut of the "Smart Parking Management Data Center" highlights its core advantage of highly integrated and upgraded hardware and software. Guoyun has taken existing roadside smart parking hardware—such as smart magnetic sensors, high/medium/low‑level imaging recognition poles, and license‑plate recognition systems—and fully incorporated them into a back‑office intelligent management center and AI computing platform, breaking the previous limitation of fragmented, standalone hardware operation.

Chairman Zhang Yichun explained that the deep hardware‑software convergence allows the management center to link on‑site equipment, real‑time video monitoring, and frontline operations staff, feeding parking data from across the city into the center. This creates a collaborative mechanism of "device connectivity × data monitoring × data integration." With a giant monitoring wall and visual dashboards, managers can instantly see ticket issuance volume, real‑time turnover rates, payment progress, and collection dynamics, turning raw hardware‑collected information into traceable, actionable smart‑governance decisions.

The platform also features advanced road‑segment pressure analysis, accurately identifying high‑demand hotspots and peak stress points. Coupled with complaint and service‑quality metrics, it helps municipal authorities flexibly adjust rates, scientifically allocate loading‑zone slots, and schedule patrol personnel, achieving the goal of "using data to highlight governance priorities and boost citizen satisfaction."

Currently, China Insurance has first built this "Smart Parking Management Data Center" in Taichung, embodying public‑private cooperation toward smart governance and a low‑carbon sustainable city layout. General Manager Gu Changhao of Guoyun Smart Parking said parking spaces are more than static facilities; they are sensory nodes reflecting urban pulse. The fully integrated hardware‑software system not only creates a high‑efficiency, financially viable smart‑parking demonstration for Taiwan, but also, through paperless ticketing and intelligent vehicle‑guidance, dramatically cuts vehicle circling emissions. Going forward, China Insurance and Guoyun Smart Parking will continue partnering with municipal governments, using technology to empower city management and jointly advance toward smarter, more sustainable low‑carbon cities.

items.title: 鉅亨速報 - Factset 最新調查：視陽(6782-TW)目標價調升至300.5元，幅度約4.34%
items.title_en: Jutong Flash - FactSet Latest Survey: VisYuan (6782-TW) Target Price Raised to NT$300.5, About 4.34% Increase
paras: 根據FactSet最新調查，共6位分析師，對視陽(6782-TW)提出目標價估值：中位數由288元上修至300.5元，調升幅度4.34%。其中最高估值306元，最低估值200元。
綜合評級 - 共有6位分析師給予視陽(6782-TW)評價：積極樂觀5位、保持中立1位、保守悲觀0位。
視陽(6782-TW)今(19日)收盤價為254元。近5日股價上漲2.83%，相關生技醫療近5日下跌3.28%，集中市場加權指數下跌5.03%，股價漲幅表現優於大盤。
資料來源：Factset，數據僅供參考，不作為投資建議。
paras_en: According to FactSet’s latest survey, six analysts provided target price estimates for VisYuan (6782‑TW). The median target was revised upward from NT$288 to NT$300.5, a 4.34% increase. The highest estimate is NT$306 and the lowest is NT$200.
Composite rating – a total of six analysts rated VisYuan (6782‑TW): five are bullish, one is neutral, and none are bearish.

VisYuan (6782‑TW) closed at NT$254 on the 19th. Over the past five days the stock rose 2.83%, while the related biotech‑health sector fell 3.28% and the broader market weighted index dropped 5.03%, meaning the stock outperformed the market.

items.title: 全球獨家主辦行 滙豐協助華碩完成首筆20億美元海外聯貸
items.title_en: Global Lead Arranger HSBC Helps Asus Complete First $2 Billion Overseas Syndicated Loan
paras: 滙豐銀行近期透過跨市場團隊合作，成功協助華碩在新加坡的全資子公司ASUS Global Pte. Ltd.完成總額 20 億美元的聯貸融資。本案是華碩成立以來首度在海外資本市場進行聯貸，深具指標性意義。本次融資將提升華碩集團的流動性與財務彈性，支持其營運成長及擴張計畫。
本次交易獲得參貸銀行的熱烈支持，原本預計募集10億美元，在金融同業踴躍參貸下，最終簽約金額上調至20億美元。此結果充分反映市場對華碩業務實力及長期前景的信心，也展現滙豐協助首次進行聯貸籌資的客戶完成大規模融資的能力。滙豐銀行於本交易中擔任獨家協調行、統籌主辦行及簿記行，和融資代理行，彰顯滙豐透過亞太區團隊合作，將市場需求轉化為客戶融資成果的實力。
滙豐(台灣)商業銀行總經理陳志堅表示：「我們很榮幸協助華碩完成其首筆20億美元海外聯貸融資。這項交易展現滙豐將深厚的台灣市場經驗、全球網絡及跨境融資能力相結合，為客戶提供具規模的全方位融資方案。隨著華碩拓展人工智慧伺服器及資料中心解決方案等新領域，我們期待持續支持其業務發展及全球布局。」

華碩電腦財務長暨發言人吳長榮表示：「全球正邁入 AI 超級週期，AI應用的需求快速攀升。華碩深耕品牌價值、凝聚創新研發能量、並與全球銷售通路與平台夥伴緊密合作，將持續完善涵蓋Cloud AI、Edge AI與Physical AI的全方位AI布局，這次聯貸獲得國際銀行團的支持，將為我們深化AI應用、拓展全球布局挹注穩健動能。在Ubiquitous AI, Incredible Possibilities的策略下，華碩將致力於落實從雲端至邊緣的 AI 應用，滿足全球企業用戶與個人用戶的多元需求。」
滙豐亞太區銀團貸款組主管邵熙 (Ashish Sharma)表示：「這項交易凝聚了滙豐台灣、新加坡及香港團隊的專業力量。透過團隊對當地市場的深入了解、豐富的聯貸融資經驗及緊密合作，我們為華碩量身打造並順利執行其首筆海外聯貸，展現滙豐跨境協作及整合專業能力，協助客戶拓展全球業務。」
滙豐銀行以客戶需求為核心，從預先識別客戶融資需求，到跨境大型融資、聯貸結構設計、交易執行及分銷，提供完整的一站式服務。滙豐台灣今年首度榮獲《歐元雜誌》(Euromoney)「台灣最佳大型企業銀行」殊榮，並連續第二年獲頒「台灣最佳債券資本市場投資銀行」大獎，持續扮演台灣企業拓展海外市場的重要金融夥伴。
paras_en: HSBC recently, through collaboration of its cross‑market teams, successfully helped Asus, via its wholly‑owned Singapore subsidiary ASUS Global Pte. Ltd., complete a syndicated loan totaling US$2 billion. This is the first overseas syndicated loan for Asus since its founding, marking a landmark achievement. The financing will boost the group’s liquidity and financial flexibility, supporting its operational growth and expansion plans.

The transaction received enthusiastic support from participating banks. Initially targeting US$1 billion, strong lender interest drove the final signed amount up to US$2 billion. This outcome reflects market confidence in Asus’s business strength and long‑term outlook, and showcases HSBC’s ability to help a client raise large‑scale financing in its first syndicated loan. HSBC acted as exclusive coordinator, lead arranger, book‑runner and financing agent, demonstrating its Asia‑Pacific team’s capability to turn market demand into client financing results.

HSBC Taiwan Commercial Bank General Manager Chen Chih‑Chien said: “We are honored to assist Asus in completing its first US$2 billion overseas syndicated loan. The deal demonstrates how HSBC combines deep Taiwan market experience, a global network and cross‑border financing expertise to deliver large‑scale, full‑service financing solutions. As Asus expands into AI servers and data‑center solutions, we look forward to continuing to support its business development and global footprint.”

Asus CFO and spokesperson Wu Chang‑Jung said: “The world is entering an AI super‑cycle, with demand for AI applications soaring. Asus, rooted in brand value, concentrated R&D innovation, and close collaboration with global sales channels and platform partners, will keep enhancing its comprehensive AI strategy covering Cloud AI, Edge AI and Physical AI. This syndicated loan, backed by an international banking syndicate, will inject robust momentum into deepening AI applications and expanding our global presence. Under the ‘Ubiquitous AI, Incredible Possibilities’ strategy, Asus is committed to delivering AI solutions from cloud to edge to meet the diverse needs of enterprise and consumer users worldwide.”

HSBC Asia‑Pacific Syndicated Loans Head Ashish Sharma said: “This deal brought together the professional strengths of HSBC teams in Taiwan, Singapore and Hong Kong. Leveraging deep local market knowledge, extensive syndicated‑loan experience and close teamwork, we tailored and executed Asus’s first overseas syndication, showcasing HSBC’s cross‑border collaboration and integrated expertise in helping clients grow globally.”

HSBC places client needs at the core, from early identification of financing requirements to cross‑border large‑scale financing, syndication structuring, transaction execution and distribution, offering a complete one‑stop service. HSBC Taiwan was this year’s first recipient of Euromoney’s “Best Large Corporate Bank in Taiwan” award and won the “Best Bond Capital Markets Investment Bank in Taiwan” award for the second consecutive year, continuing to serve as a key financial partner for Taiwanese companies expanding overseas.

items.title: 宜進近3個月買進廣達940張 每股均價320.4元
items.title_en: Yijin bought 940 shares of Quanta in the past three months at an average price of NT$320.4 per share
paras: 紡織廠宜進(1457-TW)今(19)日公告，與子公司億東合計自7月17日至10月19日，取得廣達(2382-TW)股票940張，交易總金額約3.01億元，平均每股價格約320.4元，目的為提高資金運用效益。
宜進集團此次取得廣達股票，其中宜進買進500張，平均每股價格約320.32元；億東則買進440張，平均每股價格約320.46元。截至目前，宜進及子公司累計持有廣達460張，投資金額約1.49億元。
回顧先前買賣情形，宜進於與子公司億東自3月9日至7月16日合計取得廣達股票1,093張，但宜進與億東也於3月27日至9月4日期間，處分廣達股票共1,233張，處分利益約1,676.8萬元。
paras_en: Textile firm Yijin (1457‑TW) announced today (19) that together with its subsidiary Yidong, from July 17 to October 19 it acquired 940 shares of Quanta (2382‑TW) for a total transaction amount of about NT$301 million, at an average price of roughly NT$320.4 per share, aiming to improve capital utilization efficiency.

In this purchase, Yijin bought 500 shares at an average price of about NT$320.32 per share, while Yidong bought 440 shares at an average price of about NT$320.46 per share. To date, Yijin and its subsidiary hold a cumulative 460 shares of Quanta, representing an investment of roughly NT$149 million.

Reviewing prior trading activity, Yijin and its subsidiary Yidong together acquired 1,093 shares of Quanta from March 9 to July 16, but they also disposed of 1,233 Quanta shares between March 27 and September 4, realizing disposal gains of approximately NT$16.768 million.

items.title: 神達旗下神雲科技二度回台投資 斥126億元建楊梅新廠、擴增產線
items.title_en: ShenDa subsidiary ShenYun Technology invests in Taiwan for the second time, spending NT$12.62 billion to build a new plant in Yangmei and expand production lines
paras: AI 浪潮持續發酵，帶動高階伺服器與 AI 基礎架構需求劇增。投資台灣事務所今（16）日通過神達 (3706-TW) 旗下子公司神雲科技申請「歡迎台商回台投資行動方案」擴大投資布局，預計砸下重金約 126.2 億元，於桃園市楊梅區興建全新廠房，並於既有竹南廠及林口廠擴增產線，預估將為國內新增 300 個本國就業機會。
神雲科技為神達控股子公司，長期以 MiTAC Computing 品牌服務全球市場，專注提供資料中心與企業級伺服器解決方案。隨著 AI 運算需求衝高，神雲科技近年積極從伺服器平台進一步走向機櫃與 AI 叢集整合，同時全面布局 OCP 開放運算架構，並研發從氣冷到液冷的先進散熱方案，打造涵蓋運算、儲存、網路與散熱的完整 AI 基礎架構，協助全球客戶提升整體效能，大幅創造更高的產品附加價值。
為進一步深化在台灣的高階製造優勢，神雲科技二度申請「歡迎台商回台投資行動方案」。本次規劃的 126.2 億元大投資，將全面導入智慧物聯網（AIoT）、智能倉儲與物流、伺服器自動組裝，以及 AI 電腦視覺檢測設備，大幅升級產線運作彈性與製造精度。同時，廠區也同步建置企業級 AI 算力中心，支援巨量資料分析、智慧排程與數位孿生驗證，加速公司整體營運的智慧化決策。
在綠能與永續發展方面，全案廠房建置導入 BIM 精準施工、智慧能源管理系統（EMS）與太陽能發電設施，全力爭取美國 LEED 黃金級綠建築認證，落實低碳永續目標。業界預估，待此投資案完成後，神雲科技將能顯著擴大高階伺服器及整機櫃產品產能，並進一步鞏固與強化台灣在全球 AI 產業供應鏈中的戰略關鍵地位。
根據經濟部最新統計，截至目前「投資台灣三大方案」已成功吸引 1,830 家企業、累計投資高達約 2 兆 8,435 億元，預估創造 17 萬 481 個本國就業機會。其中，「台商方案」共有 368 家企業參與，總投資金額約 1 兆 5,484 億元，帶來 9 萬 7,136 個就業機會。政府官員透露，目前後續尚有 14 家廠商排隊等待審查，顯示企業擴大在台投資意願依然強勁。
paras_en: The AI wave continues to ferment, driving a surge in demand for high‑end servers and AI infrastructure. The Investment Taiwan office approved on the 16th that ShenYun Technology, a subsidiary of MiTAC (3706‑TW), will expand its investment under the “Welcome Taiwanese Investors Back to Taiwan” program, planning to spend about NT$12.62 billion to build a brand‑new factory in Yangmei District, Taoyuan City, and to add production lines at its existing Zhunan and Linkou plants, which is expected to create roughly 300 domestic jobs.

ShenYun Technology, a MiTAC holding subsidiary, has long served the global market under the MiTAC Computing brand, focusing on data‑center and enterprise‑grade server solutions. As AI compute demand climbs, ShenYun has recently moved beyond server platforms toward rack‑level and AI‑cluster integration, fully embracing OCP open‑compute architecture and developing advanced cooling solutions from air‑ to liquid‑cooling, creating a complete AI infrastructure that covers compute, storage, networking and thermal management to help global customers boost overall performance and generate higher product value.

To further deepen its high‑end manufacturing advantage in Taiwan, ShenYun is applying for the “Welcome Taiwanese Investors Back to Taiwan” program for the second time. The NT$12.62 billion investment will comprehensively introduce AIoT, smart warehousing and logistics, automated server assembly, and AI computer‑vision inspection equipment, greatly enhancing production‑line flexibility and manufacturing precision. At the same time, the site will host an enterprise‑grade AI computing center to support massive data analytics, intelligent scheduling and digital‑twin verification, accelerating smart decision‑making across the company.

Regarding green energy and sustainability, the entire plant will incorporate BIM‑based precision construction, a smart energy‑management system (EMS) and solar power facilities, aiming for U.S. LEED Gold certification and a low‑carbon, sustainable footprint. Industry analysts estimate that once the project is completed, ShenYun will significantly expand capacity for high‑end servers and full‑rack products, further consolidating Taiwan’s strategic role in the global AI supply chain.

According to the latest Ministry of Economic Affairs statistics, the three major “Invest Taiwan” programs have so far attracted 1,830 companies with cumulative investments of about NT$2.08435 trillion, projected to create 174,481 domestic jobs. Of these, the “Taiwanese Investor” scheme involves 368 companies with total investments of roughly NT$1.05484 trillion, generating 97,136 jobs. Government officials said another 14 firms are currently queued for review, indicating that corporate appetite for expanding investment in Taiwan remains strong.

items.title: TLC-KY長效止痛新藥臨床三期解盲成功 力拚明年底至後年初在美上市
items.title_en: TLC-KY’s Long-Acting Post‑Surgical Pain Drug Hits Phase‑III Primary Endpoint, Aims for U.S. Launch by End‑2025 or Early‑2026
paras: TLC-KY(7924-TW)今(19)日召開重訊記者會，宣布旗下術後長效型止痛新藥TLC590用於拇指外翻手術的臨床三期試驗初步分析結果出爐，成功達成主要療效指標，預計明年上半年向美國FDA提出新藥上市申請(NDA)，並同步籌備商業化，力拚明年底至後年初於美國上市。
根據試驗結果，TLC590相較安慰劑可顯著減輕術後72小時內疼痛並降低鴉片類止痛藥使用。即使與目前美國市場主流的長效局部麻醉藥脂質體布比卡因(Exparel)直接比較，TLC590在止痛效果及鴉片類止痛藥用量2項次要療效指標上，同樣展現統計上的顯著優勢。
另外，TLC590於術後7天(168小時)內的整體疼痛控制，也顯著優於安慰劑及脂質體布比卡因。TLC-KY指出，此一結果凸顯TLC590具止痛與減少鴉片類止痛藥使用的潛力。

至於市場現況，TLC-KY表示，目前美國已上市的長效型局部麻醉止痛藥以脂質體布比卡因(Exparel)為主；依其製造商Pacira BioSciences, Inc.於2026年2月26日公布的2025年度財務報告，Exparel 2025年全年產品淨銷售額約5.75億美元，較2024年的5.49億美元成長約5%。此外，Viatris Inc.也於2026年10月8日宣布將以總股權價值約16.5億美元收購Pacira BioSciences, Inc.，反映國際藥廠對此一市場的高度重視。
paras_en: TLC‑KY (7924‑TW) held a major press conference today (19th) to announce that the preliminary analysis of its Phase‑III trial of the long‑acting post‑operative pain drug TLC590 in hallux valgus surgery met the primary efficacy endpoint. The company plans to file a New Drug Application (NDA) with the U.S. FDA in the first half of next year and is simultaneously preparing for commercialization, targeting a U.S. market launch by the end of next year or early the following year.

The trial results showed that, compared with placebo, TLC590 significantly reduced pain within the first 72 hours after surgery and lowered the use of opioid analgesics. Even when directly compared with the current market‑leading long‑acting liposomal bupivacaine (Exparel) in the United States, TLC590 demonstrated statistically significant advantages on the two secondary endpoints of pain relief and opioid consumption.

In addition, overall pain control within seven days (168 hours) after surgery was also significantly better with TLC590 than with placebo or liposomal bupivacaine. TLC‑KY highlighted that this underscores the drug’s potential to provide analgesia while reducing opioid use.

Regarding market conditions, TLC‑KY noted that the only long‑acting local‑anesthetic pain product currently approved in the U.S. is liposomal bupivacaine (Exparel). According to Pacira BioSciences, Inc.’s 2025 financial report released on February 26, 2026, Exparel generated net product sales of about $575 million for 2025, roughly a 5% increase from $549 million in 2024. Moreover, Viatris Inc. announced on October 8, 2026 that it will acquire Pacira BioSciences, Inc. for an equity value of approximately $1.65 billion, reflecting strong international pharmaceutical interest in this market.

items.title: 不只GPU！輝達CPU搶下Modal業務 挑戰英特爾、超微
items.title_en: Not Just GPUs! Nvidia’s CPU Wins Modal Business, Challenging Intel and AMD
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US)拓展中央處理器(CPU)市場再下一城。快速成長的AI雲端新創Modal宣布，將首次採用輝達新款Vera處理器，執行可替使用者完成長時間任務的AI代理。這類工作過去全由英特爾(INTC-US)與超微(AMD-US)晶片負責，顯示輝達進軍兩大對手長期主導的市場已有初步成果。
Modal向AI開發者出租算力，上周完成由Accel領投的7.5億美元募資，估值達157.5億美元。公司表示，服務使用量已增至原本三倍，營收較去年同期成長逾15倍，未來一年營收可望達10億美元。
Modal周一(19日)表示，初步測試顯示，Vera讓AI代理可完成的工作量提高至原本兩倍，促使公司首度支援輝達的CPU設計，但也需要對軟體進行深入調整。
不過，執行長伯恩哈德森(Erik Bernhardsson)強調，Modal不會放棄既有供應商，而是將輝達晶片與英特爾、超微產品搭配使用，依各項任務需求，分配至表現最好的硬體。
他也指出，這次測試比較的是英特爾與超微已上市的晶片，兩家公司正在開發的新款產品，可能縮小與輝達的差距。Modal將在新品推出後測試，混合使用不同供應商硬體，能讓公司隨時部署效能最佳的產品。
輝達先前向投資人表示，預期本會計年度Vera銷售額至少達200億美元，藉此切入公司估計規模約2,000億美元的CPU市場。除了Modal，輝達曾透露，OpenAI、Anthropic、甲骨文(ORCL-US)及Perplexity等業者也計畫採用Vera，擴大其在AI運算領域的布局。
paras_en: Nvidia (NVDA-US) scores another win as it expands into the central processing unit (CPU) market. Fast‑growing AI cloud startup Modal announced it will for the first time use Nvidia’s new Vera processor to run AI agents that can handle long‑duration tasks for users. Such workloads have historically been handled exclusively by Intel (INTC-US) and AMD (AMD-US) chips, showing that Nvidia is beginning to make inroads into a market long dominated by its two biggest rivals.

Modal rents compute power to AI developers and last week closed a $750 million financing round led by Accel, valuing the company at $15.75 billion. The firm said usage of its services has risen to three times its prior level and revenue has grown more than 15‑fold year‑over‑year, with revenue expected to reach $1 billion within the next year.

On Monday (the 19th), Modal reported that early tests show Vera doubles the amount of work AI agents can accomplish, prompting the company to support Nvidia’s CPU design for the first time, though it also requires deep software adjustments.

However, CEO Erik Bernhardsson stressed that Modal will not abandon its existing suppliers; instead it will pair Nvidia chips with Intel and AMD products, allocating tasks to the hardware that delivers the best performance for each workload.

He also noted that the comparison in this test involved Intel’s and AMD’s currently available chips, and that new products the two companies are developing could narrow the gap with Nvidia. Modal will test after the new releases, and a hybrid approach using hardware from different vendors will allow the company to deploy the most efficient solutions at any time.

Nvidia previously told investors it expects Vera sales to reach at least $20 billion this fiscal year, giving it a foothold in the roughly $200 billion CPU market it estimates. In addition to Modal, Nvidia has disclosed that OpenAI, Anthropic, Oracle (ORCL-US) and Perplexity also plan to use Vera, expanding its footprint in AI computing.

items.title: 美股兩大力量死鬥！美債殖利率狂飆 AI股賺翻也難漲
items.title_en: U.S. Stocks Clash Between Two Forces: Soaring Treasury Yields and AI Stocks Struggle to Rise
paras: 華爾街正迎來一場高風險的正面交鋒。科技與能源巨頭亮眼的企業獲利，正硬生生撞上持續狂飆的債券殖利率。
在人工智慧（AI）技術基礎設施與資料中心建置潮的推動下，法人分析師預期企業獲利將持續強勁成長。正是這份高昂的期待，支撐著標普500等主要指數今年一路克服多重利空。
伊朗局勢推升國際油價衝破每桶百元大關，讓本就承受高物價壓力的消費者負擔加劇；與此同時，10年期與30年期美國公債殖利率攀升至數十年新高，更為股市增添了一道沉重的逆風。
市場走向雙軌化：AI概念股獨撐大局後轉弱
殖利率飆升加劇了美股市場的分化。阿波羅全球管理公司首席經濟學家史洛克（Torsten Slok）指出，當前市場已裂變為「AI概念股」與「非AI概念股」兩大陣營。
自8月起，大盤漲勢明顯收窄，即使大多數個股陷入苦戰，主要指數表面上仍維持高檔。這股平衡直到過去一週才破功，原先強勢的AI概念股突然遭遇賣壓。
雪上加霜的是，即使油價持續走高，美債殖利率出現回檔，反映市場避險情緒升溫；投資人則順勢轉回先前受高利率壓抑的類股與個股。
財報門檻大幅提高：投資人開始質疑AI成長故事
數月以來，投資人將焦點全數鎖定在獲利表現，使AI概念股幾乎免疫於小型股及其他利率敏感股所承受的打擊。
然而，隨著市場對AI驅動的成長敘事開始存疑，這些股票要繼續推升股價的門檻已大幅提高。
在大型銀行與百事可樂（PepsiCo）等消費巨頭搶先公布的財報未能驚艷市場後，恢復市場信心 重擔，已落在即將公布最新財測與業績的AI核心受益股身上。
Nationwide首席市場策略師哈克特（Mark Hackett）直言：「市場的疑慮正持續升溫。」
獲利爆發力對決資金成本：估值修正引發長短力道拉鋸
隨著債券殖利率上周五(16日)繼續攀升，市場似乎正走向兩股強大力量的拉鋸。
Founders 100 ETF投資組合經理莫納漢（Michael Monaghan）表示，一方面，企業獲利成長速度已達到通常只有經濟復甦初期才會出現的強勁水準；另一方面，推升債券殖利率的力量，短期內似乎不太可能消退。
莫納漢表示：「市場正處於拉鋸之中。儘管今年以來股市上漲，但相較於明年的獲利預估，目前股價已便宜許多。」
雖然股價仍有支撐，估值，也就是投資人願意為每一美元預期獲利支付的價格，卻已明顯下滑。根據FactSet資料，截至上周五，標普500指數的預估本益比為19倍，低於過去5年與10年的平均水準。
富達投資全球總經主管提默（Jurrien Timmer）表示，認為科技股能免受日益加劇的總體經濟壓力影響，並不完全正確。
提默在訪談中表示：「可以把它想成獲利成長在分子、資金成本在分母。目前獲利正突飛猛進，但資金成本也在上升。兩者正在競速，就看哪一方對股價的影響更大。」
paras_en: Wall Street is facing a high‑risk head‑to‑head battle. Stellar earnings from tech and energy giants are colliding head‑on with continuously soaring bond yields.

Driven by the wave of AI infrastructure and data‑center construction, sell‑side analysts expect corporate earnings to keep growing strongly. This lofty expectation has helped major indices such as the S&P 500 overcome multiple headwinds this year.

Iran’s situation has pushed international oil prices above $100 a barrel, further burdening consumers already feeling high price pressure; at the same time, 10‑year and 30‑year U.S. Treasury yields have climbed to multi‑decade highs, adding a heavy headwind for equities.
The market is moving on two tracks: AI‑related stocks, after initially supporting the market, are now weakening.

Yield spikes have intensified the split in the U.S. equity market. Torsten Slok, chief economist at Apollo Global Management, notes that the market has now fractured into two camps – “AI‑themed stocks” and “non‑AI stocks.”

Since August, the broad market’s rally has noticeably narrowed. Even though many individual stocks are struggling, the main indices have superficially stayed at elevated levels. This balance only broke in the past week, when once‑strong AI stocks suddenly faced selling pressure.

Adding insult to injury, even as oil prices keep rising, Treasury yields have pulled back, reflecting heightened market‑risk aversion; investors are shifting back into sectors and stocks that were previously suppressed by high rates.
Earnings thresholds have risen sharply: investors begin to doubt the AI growth story
For months, investors have focused exclusively on earnings performance, making AI‑themed stocks almost immune to the blows that hit small‑caps and other rate‑sensitive stocks.
However, as the market’s confidence in AI‑driven growth narratives wanes, the hurdle for these stocks to keep pushing prices higher has risen dramatically.

After earnings from large banks and consumer giants such as PepsiCo failed to wow the market, the burden of restoring confidence now falls on AI‑core beneficiaries that are about to release fresh forecasts and results.
Mark Hackett, chief market strategist at Nationwide, said plainly: “Market concerns are continuing to heat up.”
Earnings explosiveness versus funding costs: valuation adjustments spark a tug‑of‑war between long and short forces
With bond yields continuing to climb on Friday the 16th, the market appears to be caught in a tug‑of‑war between two powerful forces.

Michael Monaghan, portfolio manager of the Founders 100 ETF, said that on one hand, corporate earnings growth has reached a robust pace normally seen only in the early stages of an economic recovery; on the other hand, the forces driving yields higher seem unlikely to subside in the short term.
Monaghan added: “The market is in a tug‑of‑war. Although stocks have risen so far this year, relative to next year’s earnings outlook, today’s prices are already much cheaper.”

While stock prices still have support, valuations – the price investors are willing to pay for each dollar of expected earnings – have clearly slipped. According to FactSet, as of last Friday the S&P 500’s forward P/E ratio stood at 19×, below the five‑year and ten‑year averages.
Jurrien Timmer, global chief economist at Fidelity Investments, said it is not entirely correct to think technology stocks are insulated from the growing macro‑economic pressures.

Timmer explained in an interview: “You can think of it as earnings growth in the numerator and funding costs in the denominator. Earnings are surging, but funding costs are rising too. The two are racing, and it will depend on which side has the bigger impact on stock prices.”

items.title: 工廠八成自動化！西門子攜輝達 用AI拚製造競爭力
items.title_en: Factory Automation Hits 80%: Siemens Teams Up with Nvidia to Boost Manufacturing Competitiveness with AI
paras: 西門子(SIEGY-US)執行董事奈克(Cedrik Neike)周一(19日)表示，公司計畫運用人工智慧(AI)，將工廠製造流程的自動化程度由目前的30%至40%，提高至70%至80%，藉此提升生產效率，協助德國等高薪資國家留住製造業工作機會。
奈克在西門子位於德國埃爾朗根(Erlangen)的電子工廠表示，製造商必須每年實現7%至9%的生產力成長，才能維持競爭力。他認為，AI帶動的自動化升級，有助於高薪資國家維持製造業競爭優勢。
西門子正與輝達(NVDA-US)合作，推動「實體AI」在製造業的應用，透過數位孿生與AI模型，先在虛擬環境中模擬、優化工廠運作，再將成果導入實際生產現場。
西門子也計畫將埃爾朗根電子工廠打造成AI製造示範基地，並於2030年前投入5億歐元，約合5.61億美元，擴建廠區。
paras_en: Siemens (SIEGY-US) Executive Director Cedrik Neike said on Monday (the 19th) that the company plans to use artificial intelligence (AI) to raise the automation level of factory manufacturing processes from the current 30‑40% to 70‑80%, thereby improving production efficiency and helping high‑wage countries such as Germany retain manufacturing jobs.

Neike explained at Siemens' electronics plant in Erlangen, Germany, that manufacturers must achieve 7%‑9% productivity growth each year to stay competitive. He believes that AI‑driven automation upgrades will help high‑wage nations maintain a manufacturing advantage.

Siemens is collaborating with Nvidia (NVDA-US) to promote the use of “physical AI” in manufacturing, employing digital twins and AI models to simulate and optimise plant operations in a virtual environment before applying the results to real‑world production lines.
Siemens also intends to turn the Erlangen electronics plant into an AI‑manufacturing demonstration hub, investing €500 million (about $561 million) by 2030 to expand the facility.

items.title: 通膨才見降溫又升溫！哈塞特坦言仍需下功夫 Fed須留意消費熱度
items.title_en: Inflation Cools Then Heats Up Again! Hassett Says More Work Needed, Fed Must Watch Consumer Heat
paras: 宮國家經濟委員會主任哈塞特(Kevin Hassett)周一(19日)表示，牛肉、雞蛋等商品價格雖已下跌，但美國9月消費者物價數據顯示，整體通膨仍需要政策關注。他也指出，民眾對經濟表現樂觀、增加消費，是聯準會(Fed)必須留意的現象。
哈塞特接受《CNBC》訪問時表示：「如果看前面三個月，通膨看起來已完全受到控制，但現在似乎又需要下一番功夫。」
上周公布的數據顯示，美國9月消費者物價指數(CPI)月增0.6%，創五個月來最大漲幅；排除食品與能源的核心CPI月增0.3%，高於市場預期，反映潛在物價壓力仍未消退。
對於最新數據是否意味通膨趨勢轉變，哈塞特並未下定論。他表示：「這可能代表下降趨勢被打斷，也可能只是短暫波動。」
在通膨再度受到關注之際，市場預期Fed將於本月底會議維持利率不變。Fed主席華許(Kevin Warsh)上周出席國際貨幣基金(IMF)年會的一場座談時，除了重申Fed將實現物價穩定，並未評論貨幣政策或美國經濟展望，也未打消市場對利率按兵不動的預期。
哈塞特表示，他尊重央行獨立性，相信華許會「做他認為正確的事」。
他同時指出，強勁的消費意願也是Fed評估政策時需要考量的因素。「人們對經濟表現如此良好感到非常振奮，因此增加支出。當然，這正是Fed需要留意的情況。」
paras_en: Kevin Hassett, director of the White House Council of Economic Advisers, said on Monday (the 19th) that while prices for items such as beef and eggs have fallen, September U.S. consumer price data show that overall inflation still requires policy attention. He also noted that the public’s optimism about the economy and increased spending are phenomena the Federal Reserve must monitor.
In an interview with CNBC, Hassett said, "If you look at the past three months, inflation seemed fully under control, but now it looks like we need to put in another round of effort."

Data released last week showed that the U.S. September Consumer Price Index (CPI) rose 0.6% month‑over‑month, the biggest increase in five months; the core CPI, which excludes food and energy, rose 0.3% month‑over‑month, above market expectations, indicating that underlying price pressures have not yet eased.

When asked whether the latest data signaled a shift in the inflation trend, Hassett did not draw a firm conclusion. He said, "It could mean the downward trend was interrupted, or it could just be a temporary blip."

As inflation comes back into focus, markets expect the Fed to keep rates unchanged at its meeting at the end of the month. Fed Chair Kevin Warsh, who attended a panel at the IMF annual meeting last week, reiterated the Fed’s commitment to price stability but did not comment on monetary policy, the U.S. economic outlook, or dispel expectations that rates would stay on hold.
Hassett said he respects the central bank’s independence and believes Warsh will "do what he thinks is right."

He also pointed out that strong consumer willingness to spend is a factor the Fed must consider when evaluating policy. "People are so encouraged by the good economic performance that they increase spending. Of course, that’s exactly what the Fed needs to watch."

items.title: 別急著低接科技股！那指反彈淪「假突破」 分析師示警這次不一樣
items.title_en: Don't Rush to Buy Tech Stocks Low! Nasdaq Rally Turns Into a "False Breakout" – Analysts Warn This Time Is Different
paras: 每當有人聲稱「這次不一樣」，華爾街往往抱持懷疑態度，因為市場趨勢經常比預期維持得更久。
儘管目前要斷言科技股的長期多頭格局已經結束或許尚早，但多項技術指標已明確發出「切勿盲目抄底」的訊號，即使「逢低承接」策略今年以來多次奏效，甚至上個月才剛帶來豐厚回報。
代表科技股重要風向球的那斯達克綜合指數，科技類股權重高達64.9%。儘管該指數在上周四出現強勁反彈，但從技術線型來看，最糟糕的時刻恐怕尚未過去。
上周五(16日)那斯達克指數重挫2.1%，收在近一個月新低，並創下四個月來最大單周跌幅。
跌破50日線 上升趨勢線也失守
Piper Sandler首席市場技術分析師Craig Johnson並未直接宣稱「這次不一樣」，但他指出，這波回檔確實有別於先前。他觀察到市場整體狀況已明顯惡化，足以判斷中期趨勢正在轉弱，並表示：「我現在不急著逢低買進。」
FactSet數據顯示，那指周五收在26,140點，低於26,631點的50日移動平均線。許多技術分析人士將50日均線視為短期趨勢指標，因此收盤跌破這條均線，意味短線趨勢已轉為下行。
不過，這並非新現象。那指先前曾多次跌破50日均線，卻未破壞長期上升趨勢。最近一次就在上個月，當時指數連續兩天收在50日均線下方，卻在僅三個交易日後大漲，收盤再創歷史新高。
這次的一大差異在於，先前跌破50日均線時的低點，反而構成了自3月30日近八個月低點延伸而上的上升趨勢線。當趨勢線至少連接三個點時，技術意義就更為明確。
如今那指跌破這條上升趨勢線，成為本輪賣壓有別於近期幾次回檔的另一項訊號。
創高淪為假突破 短線恐續盤整
Johnson進一步指出，那指線圖顯示，在指數突破並於9月底、10月初創下歷史新高後追買科技股的投資人，遭到突破訊號誤導。
他在客戶報告中寫道，那指跌破前一周低點，也失守先前推動指數於10月初創高的支撐位，形成「創新高後假突破」型態。
他表示，雖然這本身尚不足以扭轉主要上升趨勢，「但確實意味短期內可能出現盤整或回檔」。
市場廣度疲弱 上漲個股不足三成
Johnson補充，目前市場內部結構相當疲弱，也是這次與那指9月及7月回檔不同的另一項技術面因素。
他指出，根據其趨勢分析，處於周線上升趨勢的股票占比不到27%；公司追蹤的26周新高指標與40周「Technique」指標，則仍處於年內低點，並持續發出中期賣出訊號。
FactSet數據也顯示，儘管那指上周才創下歷史新高，目前距離該高點僅回落略逾5%，但那斯達克交易所創52周新低的股票家數，已連續35天多於創52周新高的家數。
這是自2025年4月22日結束的連續43天紀錄以來，最長的一段期間。當時那指較四個月前創下的歷史收盤高點下跌19.2%。
Johnson表示：「這個市場的趨勢疲弱、市場廣度疲弱，參與上漲的個股也少。」
下一道關卡看200日線
接下來值得關注的關鍵均線是200日移動平均線，那指自3月以來尚未跌破這條均線。許多市場人士將其視為長期多空趨勢的分界線。
FactSet數據顯示，200日均線目前位於24,919點，意味那指若從周五收盤價回落至此，還有約4.7%的下跌空間。
paras_en: Whenever someone claims "this time is different," Wall Street is usually skeptical, because market trends often persist longer than expected.

Although it may be premature to declare that the long‑term bull market in tech stocks is over, several technical indicators have clearly sounded a "do not blindly bottom‑fish" warning, even though the "buy the dip" strategy has worked multiple times this year and only last month delivered hefty returns.

The Nasdaq Composite, the key barometer for tech stocks, has a tech weighting of 64.9%. Although the index posted a strong rebound last Thursday, the technical chart suggests the worst may still be ahead.
On Friday (the 16th) the Nasdaq fell 2.1%, closing at a one‑month low and marking the biggest weekly drop in four months.
It broke below the 50‑day moving average and also lost its upward trend line.

Piper Sandler’s chief market technologist Craig Johnson didn’t outright say "this time is different," but he noted that this pullback is indeed unlike previous ones. He observed that overall market conditions have deteriorated enough to judge that the medium‑term trend is weakening, and he said, "I’m not in a hurry to buy on the dip right now."

FactSet data shows the index closed Friday at 26,140 points, below the 50‑day moving average of 26,631 points. Many technical analysts treat the 50‑day average as a short‑term trend indicator, so closing below it signals a shift to a downtrend in the short term.

However, this is not a new phenomenon. The Nasdaq has broken below the 50‑day average many times before without destroying the long‑term uptrend. The most recent instance was last month, when the index stayed below the 50‑day line for two consecutive days but then surged within three trading sessions to close at a new all‑time high.

The big difference this time is that the low when the index previously fell below the 50‑day average actually formed an upward trend line extending from the March 30 low, the lowest point in nearly eight months. When a trend line connects at least three points, its technical significance becomes clearer.
Now the Nasdaq has broken that upward trend line, providing another signal that this round of selling differs from the recent pullbacks.
New‑highs Turned Into False Breakouts, Short‑Term Consolidation Likely

Johnson further pointed out that the Nasdaq chart shows investors who chased tech stocks after the index broke out and set new highs at the end of September and early October were misled by the breakout signal.

In his client report he wrote that the Nasdaq fell below the prior week’s low and also broke the support that had propelled the index to its early‑October high, creating a "false breakout after a new high" pattern.
He said that while this alone is not enough to reverse the primary uptrend, it does suggest that a short‑term consolidation or pullback is possible.
Market Breadth Weak, Fewer Than 30% of Stocks Advancing
Johnson added that the internal market structure is quite weak right now, which is another technical factor distinguishing this move from the September and July pullbacks.

He noted that, according to his trend analysis, less than 27% of stocks are in a weekly uptrend; the 26‑week new‑high metric and the 40‑week "Technique" indicator that his firm tracks remain at year‑low levels and continue to emit medium‑term sell signals.

FactSet data also shows that although the Nasdaq set a fresh all‑time high just last week and is only about 5% off that peak, the number of stocks on the Nasdaq hitting 52‑week lows has outnumbered those hitting 52‑week highs for 35 consecutive days.
This is the longest stretch since a 43‑day run that ended on April 22 2025, when the Nasdaq was down 19.2% from the closing high it had set four months earlier.
Johnson said, "The market trend is weak, market breadth is weak, and there are few stocks participating in the rally."
Next Barrier: The 200‑Day Moving Average

The next key moving average to watch is the 200‑day moving average, which the Nasdaq has not broken since March. Many market participants view it as the dividing line between long‑term bullish and bearish trends.
FactSet data shows the 200‑day average is currently at 24,919 points, meaning that if the Nasdaq falls from Friday’s close back to that level, there is roughly a 4.7% downside potential.

items.title: 摩根大通投入50億美元股權投資 聚焦美國製造業、能源與國防供應鏈
items.title_en: JPMorgan Chase Invests $5 Billion in Equity, Targeting U.S. Manufacturing, Energy and Defense Supply Chains
paras: 2026年10月19日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 美國最大銀行摩根大通JPMorgan Chase(JPM-US)19日宣布，已投入50億美元（約新台幣1,622億元）進行股權投資，鎖定與美國經濟及國家安全相關的產業，包括先進製造、能源基礎設施、關鍵供應鏈及國防科技。隨著美國持續擴大本土製造與基礎設施投資，銀行業也開始透過直接持股方式參與相關產業發展。
這筆股權投資屬於摩根大通去年啟動的「安全與韌性倡議」（Security and Resiliency Initiative）。當時公司承諾，未來十年將協助美國推動總額1.5兆美元的投資計畫。根據最新公布的進度，計畫啟動一年以來，摩根大通已提供約2,300億美元融資，涵蓋美國製造業、能源及供應鏈等領域。
與傳統銀行授信不同，摩根大通此次公布的50億美元股權投資，涵蓋新創、成長期及成熟階段企業，投資方向包括新一代國防技術、分散式電池儲能、自動化製造及前沿科技。摩根大通表示，接下來將持續擴大美國工業產能、強化供應鏈，並支持與長期經濟安全相關的產業。
美國其他大型銀行也正擴大基礎設施投資。美國銀行Bank of America(BAC-US)今年8月宣布，計畫在2027年7月前投入2,500億美元，支持美國數位及基礎設施專案；摩根士丹利Morgan Stanley(MS-US)則規劃未來十年協助促成約1.5兆美元的科技及基礎設施投資。相關資金涵蓋AI資料中心、能源設施及關鍵礦產等領域。

paras_en: On October 19, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – JPMorgan Chase (JPM-US), the largest U.S. bank, announced on the 19th that it has invested $5 billion (about NT$162.2 billion) in equity, focusing on industries tied to the U.S. economy and national security, including advanced manufacturing, energy infrastructure, critical supply chains and defense technology. As the United States continues to expand domestic manufacturing and infrastructure spending, the banking sector is also beginning to participate in these industries through direct equity holdings.

The equity investment is part of JPMorgan’s “Security and Resiliency Initiative” launched last year. At that time the firm pledged to help the United States drive a $1.5 trillion investment plan over the next ten years. According to the latest progress report, in the year since the program’s launch JPMorgan has provided roughly $230 billion in financing covering U.S. manufacturing, energy and supply‑chain sectors.

Unlike traditional bank lending, the $5 billion equity commitment covers startups, growth‑stage and mature companies, with investment themes that include next‑generation defense technologies, distributed battery storage, automated manufacturing and frontier tech. JPMorgan said it will continue to expand U.S. industrial capacity, strengthen supply chains and support industries linked to long‑term economic security.

Other major U.S. banks are also scaling up infrastructure investments. Bank of America (BAC-US) announced in August that it plans to invest $250 billion by July 2027 to support U.S. digital and infrastructure projects; Morgan Stanley (MS-US) is planning to help facilitate about $1.5 trillion of technology and infrastructure investment over the next decade. The funds will target AI data centers, energy facilities and critical minerals, among other areas.
